name: Pet grooming
summary: Dog and cat grooms priced from size, coat, matting, add-ons and optional mobile travel.

items.label: Groom, medium dog, medium coat
items.source: 60 min (SIZE_TIERS.medium) x 1.15 (COAT_TYPES.medium) = 69 min; supplies $6 (defaults in calc.mjs, index.html). Wage defaults to $0 (owner-operator, '0 to skip'); in-shop, no matting or add-ons

items.label: Job overhead allocation
items.source: overhead $5 per groom (defaults in calc.mjs); the specialist allocates overhead in dollars, so overheadRate is 0

specialistModels: Size and coat time multipliers, matting surcharges with a severe-matting safety acknowledgment, add-on menu, mobile travel toggle, and a 3% payment fee on the quote.
